company.description:
Mytriphoto offers 360selfie, a service that allows Hotels to turn 360º photos into data, analytics, engagement, loyalty and new guests. This service can be stationed inside or outside hotels and resorts, so guests and visitors passing by the machine are invited to take 360° pictures and share them with social networks through their own smartphones. 

360Selfie enables hotels to create brand presence online, generate social referrals, and gain organic connections between brands and hotels, customers and guests and their social media contacts.

Mytriphoto was founded in 2014.
